text:
maya: WFH desk show-and-tell! did a cheap IKEA hack — monitor arm + plywood standing tray. cable spaghetti incoming. pic: <https://i.imgur.com/desk1.jpg|desk1.jpg> also, my ISP has been jittery this morning, anyone else?
sam: love the plant. which arm did you get? :seedling:
maya: it’s the Ergotron LX clone from Amazon, works great. had to zip-tie and velcro all the cables though.
zuri: sharing my setup too: <https://i.imgur.com/desk2.jpg|desk2.jpg> one-cable life with a USB-C dock saved me :sparkles:
chris: router restart fixed mine earlier. if you wanna debug: `ping 1.1.1.1 -t` on mac/linux to check packet loss — i saw ~40% before restart :grimacing:
ops-bot: Heads up — nightly deploy completed at 09:12 UTC. No impact to remote access. :robot_face:
nina: anyone tried Starlink as a backup? thinking of getting one for rainy season outages — curious about latency for dev work.
alex: starlink gen2 okay for general browsing and pushes, but during storms it's spotty. not great for low-latency pairing sessions. anecdotal only.
sven: cheap backup: tether to your phone (if unlimited). also, cable management before photos = free likes :trophy:
maya: @it-support any recommended chairs under $300? my posture is crying.
it-support: try Steelcase Series 1 if you can find it on sale. otherwise look at used Herman Miller Aeron on marketplace. we also have a discount portal (ask people-ops).
maya: :thumbsup: thanks y’all — will post the after-photo after cable triage.
